name: MonarchMiniMonth
title: MiniMonth
summary: A month calendar for choosing a day, with an earliest and latest day, days the app marks unavailable, ISO week numbers and up to three dots under days that have events.
whenToUse: For a calendar that shows which days have events or are available: a sidebar calendar beside an agenda, a booking day picker with unavailable days.
whenNotToUse: For entering a date in a form use the Material 3 DatePicker or DatePickerDialog, which also offer text input and a year picker. For a range of dates use the Material 3 DateRangePicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMiniMonth(selection: Long?, onSelectionChange: (Long) -> Unit, previousMonthIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, nextMonthIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, visibleMonth: Long? = null, onVisibleMonthChange: ((Long) -> Unit)? = null, minimumDate: Long? = null, maximumDate: Long? = null, today: Long? = null, firstDayOfWeek: Int? = null, showWeekNumbers: Boolean = false, showOutsideDays: Boolean = true, fixedWeeks: Boolean = true, enabled: Boolean = true, isDateDisabled: ((Long) -> Boolean)? = null, dayInfo: ((Long) -> MonarchMiniMonthDayInfo?)? = null, labels: MonarchMiniMonthLabels = MonarchMiniMonthLabels())
class MonarchMiniMonthDayInfo(dots: List<MonarchTone?>, description: String? = null) { constructor(dotCount: Int, description: String? = null); companion object { const val MAX_DOTS: Int = 3 } }
class MonarchMiniMonthLabels(previousMonth: String? = null, nextMonth: String? = null, today: String? = null, week: String? = null, weekNumber: ((Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: selection
options.description: The selected day in epoch milliseconds (any time of that UTC day), or null for none.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the day the user chooses, as the UTC midnight of that date.

options.name: previousMonthIcon
options.description: The icon of the previous-month button. Monarch bundles no icons; pass one that mirrors in right-to-left layouts, with a null content description.

options.name: nextMonthIcon
options.description: The icon of the next-month button.

options.name: visibleMonth
options.description: Any day of the month on screen. null lets the calendar keep it (saved across configuration changes), starting on the month of the selection or of today.

options.name: onVisibleMonthChange
options.description: Called with the first day of the month the user moves to.

options.name: minimumDate
options.description: The earliest day that can be chosen. Earlier months cannot be reached.

options.name: maximumDate
options.description: The latest day that can be chosen. Later months cannot be reached.

options.name: today
options.description: Today's date, for example in the workspace's time zone. null is today on the device's calendar.

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: The first column, Calendar.SUNDAY to Calendar.SATURDAY. null follows the locale of the configuration.

options.name: showWeekNumbers
options.description: Shows ISO 8601 week numbers in a column at the start.

options.name: showOutsideDays
options.description: Shows the neighbouring months' days, dimmed, not selectable and not read by TalkBack.

options.name: fixedWeeks
options.description: Always six week rows, so the height does not change between months.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether days and the month buttons can be used.

options.name: isDateDisabled
options.description: Returns true for a day that cannot be chosen. Called for every day of the month shown.

options.name: dayInfo
options.description: The dots and their description for a day: accent dots (dotCount, or null entries) or toned dots; at most three are drawn.

states.name: selected
states.description: The day's number in the accent's on-solid color on a solid accent circle; TalkBack says selected.

states.name: today
states.description: An accent ring and semibold strong accent text; TalkBack reads "Today" before the date.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: Days outside the bounds and days the app disables are in the disabled text color and cannot be chosen; days the app disables are also struck through. TalkBack says disabled.

states.name: with dots
states.description: Up to three 6dp dots under the number: the accent, or the solid color of a tone; the neutral tone is the subtle text color.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled = false: no day and no month button can be used.

appearance: Default text on the surface; weekday initials and week numbers in the subtle text color; the selected day a solid accent circle, today an accent ring. All roles follow light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map asked for a custom grid because the Material 3 DatePicker cannot show event dots or week numbers; iOS wraps UICalendarView under the same name and cannot show week numbers. The web's month and year pickers behind the title are not offered: the title is a heading, and an app that needs to jump far sets visibleMonth (or uses the Material 3 DatePicker). Also not offered: the web's highlighted range and range preview (use the Material 3 DateRangePicker), several months side by side, a footer (put a button under the calendar), and the web's keyboard grid model with arrow keys and Page Up/Down; days are reached with Tab and the platform's focus search. The web's accent dot tone is a null entry or dotCount, because MonarchTone has no accent case. Days are epoch milliseconds of their UTC midnight, as in DatePickerState, not ISO strings. Each day reserves a 48dp target, so the seven days need 336dp; narrower, the grid scrolls sideways (the web shrinks its days). Decision (C-091, closed 2026-11-15): compact day cells below 336dp are not built. The touch target wins: every day keeps a 48dp target (WCAG 2.5.8 and the Material 3 minimum), and the grid scrolls sideways on a window narrower than 336dp, 368dp with week numbers. iOS can differ because UICalendarView sizes its own days.
accessibility: Each day is one TalkBack element read as its full date in the locale ("Saturday, November 14, 2026"), with "Today" before today and the dot description after.
The selected day has the selected state; unavailable days are disabled and do not react to taps.
The month title is a heading and a polite live region, so moving to another month is announced.
The month buttons are Material 3 icon buttons named "Previous month" and "Next month", disabled at the bounds.
Every day reserves a 48dp by 48dp touch target in the layout; the grid scrolls sideways rather than shrinking it.
Days of the neighbouring months are not read and cannot be chosen.
Right to left, the first day of the week and the previous button are at the right edge.
The numbers grow with the font size setting; the day circles grow with them.
The meaning of a dot is never color alone only if the app gives a description.
edgeCases: A selection outside the bounds or on a disabled day is not shown as selected; the selection value is left as it is.
A latest day before the earliest day leaves only the earliest day available.
A visibleMonth outside the bounds shows the nearest month inside them.
isDateDisabled and dayInfo are called for every day of the month on every composition, so they must be cheap.
Days are UTC dates. today defaults to the device's local date written as a UTC midnight; pass today to use a workspace's time zone.
On a screen narrower than 336dp (368dp with week numbers) the grid scrolls sideways.
With visibleMonth set and no onVisibleMonthChange that updates it, the month buttons do not move the calendar.
